TYPE-D: incompatible definitions of ObservationV1. design.md:160–165 defines a closed capture request requiring schemaVersion, owner, kind, text and coverage, with only stableEventId optional. frontend-spec.md:20–24 instead names ObservationV1 with host, eventKind, opaque session/feature, observed text and an optional transcript locator; it does not define the required owner/coverage fields or distinguish this shape as a separate native-input type. Because unknown keys are rejected (design.md:77–83), an adapter implemented against the normative frontend shape will be rejected by the core capture contract, preventing REQ-001/008 capture. This is Major because it creates implementation mismatch at the adapter/core boundary. Use one canonical ObservationV1 definition, or give the native shape a distinct name and explicitly map it into the closed core request, including owner and coverage.
